description: Recommend what to do next on the product — read the product model (the spine `_spine.yaml` plus each slice's lens docs), build the list of every runnable or blocked action with a deterministic decision tree, order it to finish one slice before the others advance, and show ONE next-best-action plus the ordered list (≤11 entries). Reading and ordering are scripts; the play only presents. Order: repair first, then every step of the focus slice (the lowest roadmap-order slice with work left — feature track, technical track, /measure, /grill, its epics), then strategy, then other slices' steps as parallel lanes (shown, never hidden), then learning and refresh. The model is the single source: no backlog, sprint plan, or work queue exists or is consulted. Recommend ONLY: the play never modifies the model, never creates work items, never launches a play. Read-only and position none: runnable anytime, on any branch, even mid-pipeline. Use when the user asks "what next", "what should I work on", "where are we", or wants the model's work ordered.
